title: Concept: Unsafe deserialization via unserialize (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, unserialize performs object deserialization: bytes select classes and set fields, so a hostile payload can drive gadget chains or execute callbacks. The javascript-specific remedy is data-only decoding via JSON.parse with schema validation.
applicability: javascript codebases decoding persisted or received bytes through unserialize; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Object injection leading to code execution or state corruption when hostile bytes reach the sink; HIGH severity because payloads are compact and often unauthenticated.
